atoms.text: Good morning everyone and welcome to today’s show! I am making a delicious fruit smoothie. For this recipe, I need some strawberries, some blueberries and a banana. I also add some honey to make it sweet.

atoms.a: The chef is making a salty dish.

atoms.text: Finally, I pour in some milk, but you can also use water if you prefer. This smoothie is fresh, healthy and very easy to make. You can also find this recipe on our website.
